target: AFE + ADC + implemented digital decimation, modeled noise and distortion included, effective16.5bit
source_of_target_change: User explicitly requested: 一旦16.5bitを目標にしましょう・。
user_priorities: Outputs and temporary results on external disk

baseline.system_boundary: Chip input terminals through AFE/ADC/implemented decimator output; external electrode impedance/noise must be specified separately before claiming electrode-to-digital system performance

signal_reference.source_amplitude_policy: Retain the same differential open-circuit electrode-source benchmark before declared source impedance. Measure and report actual chip-terminal voltage and candidate gain; do not substitute larger-FS normalization.

source_impedance_policy.boundary: Chip input terminals through AFE/ADC/implemented decimator output; external electrode impedance/noise must be specified separately before claiming electrode-to-digital system performance
source_impedance_policy.source_noise_not_silently_removed: Preserve both intrinsic chip noise and total source-inclusive ledgers. A chip-intrinsic ENOB result does not qualify electrode-to-digital performance with unspecified external noise.

other_constraints.interface: SPI to external MCU, MCU model undecided
other_constraints.power_preference: No hard user power cap; avoid extremely large power and report measured power.

stages.name: fast_block_screen
stages.scope: op/ac/noise on frozen linear blocks, model validation and physical noise budget

stages.name: switching_block_characterization
stages.scope: actual chopping/sampling, calibrated noise sources including folding, settling and numerical convergence

stages.name: behavioral_search
stages.scope: noise/mismatch models calibrated to blocks, exact quantizer/DAC units and fixed-point decimator, multiple seeds and amplitudes

stages.name: continuous_system_verification
stages.scope: qualified candidate AFE through digital output, transistor analog and implemented digital timing, calibrated noise, explicit model limitations
include: Actual CIC/FIR response and decimation aliasing
No removed residual tones; no segment-state reset; startup discarded explicitly
stages.caution: 4 s only gives0.25Hz bins. Low-end behavior needs several0.5Hz cycles and longer settled records. Lower-amplitude SNR need not meet101.10dB; report per-input and full-scale normalization explicitly.

noise_rules: Normal .tran does not automatically include device noise
TRNOISE amplitudes/PSD/update interval require independent calibration
PDK statistical switches do not perturb ideal capacitors
No qualified ENOB until complete, valid, adequately long records exist
gain_policy: Measure signal amplitude and gain for each frequency, operating point and candidate; 31.8 is only the budget baseline, never a substitute for measured transfer.
historical_excluded_evidence: nodeset chained 72.11 dB is not an established continuous-system ceiling

provisional_headroom.status: Design-screening preference before long evaluation, not a replacement for the16.5bit acceptance threshold.

change_scope: Only the interim target ENOB and corresponding primary residual/SNDR thresholds change. Circuit/model/solver/test-source amplitude/bandwidth and evidence requirements are not relaxed.
